notes.hook: The contrast between the fastest launch in human history and a mundane postage stamp immediately grabs curiosity.
notes.clarity: The mission timeline moves cleanly from launch velocity to gravity assist, encounter, and payload reveal.
notes.payoff: Revealing the ironic 'Not Yet Explored' stamp inscription delivers an emotionally satisfying punchline to the mission.
notes.visuals: Imagery is authentic and high quality, though the Io comparison slide feels slightly dry and chart-like.
notes.loop: Resolving the delivery at the destination rolls naturally back into the opening mention of carrying the stamp.

rounds.better_than_last: It delivers a much stronger human emotional payoff at the climax than recent technical episodes.
